reuse.why: Extends the existing getCategoriesForBulkAction selection, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own parallel exclusion path instead of reusing that selection.

duplication.why: The notes join and the lower(COALESCE(note)) LIKE '%#fixed%' tag test are written twice in two SQL queries, plus a third JS check of the derived flag in copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: Changes stay in server/budget/actions.ts next to the existing exclusion rules, although the tag test is raw SQL rather than a named rule.

scope.why: Only the budget actions and their test change.

maintainability.why: The exclusion rule now has to be kept in sync in two queries and one JS condition, and the tag match is an ad hoc substring LIKE with no named definition.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth (via getBudgetData group_fixed) applies the fixed-group exclusion itself instead of going through getCategoriesForBulkAction

disguised_duplication.where: The tag test is reshaped: a CASE ... LIKE projecting group_fixed in getBudgetData plus a JS check, and a NOT LIKE filter in getCategoriesForBulkAction

one_place.where: Rule added separately in getCategoriesForBulkAction SQL and in getBudgetData SQL + copyPreviousMonth condition (packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts)
